Mew

Psychic

Kanto · Generation 1 · Mythical Pokémon

Mew is a Psychic-type New Species Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1), and is classed as a Mythical Pokémon. It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 4 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is HP (100), with a base stat total of 600.
